variant_decisions.evidence: ASV opens 'While he was yet speaking to the multitudes' with no connective, but ASV routinely leaves a transitional δέ in a genitive absolute unrendered, so the bare English does not show whether the particle stood in the text.

review_notes: The whole verse is covered by an underdetermined variant with the base among the compatible readings; the ASV's own note records that some authorities omit the verse, but the projection supplies it and every token aligns.

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV prints verse 47 in the text with the mapped textual_variant note 'Some ancient authorities omit verse 47', which puts the omission in the margin and excludes r02. The two readings that retain the verse are identical in wording, so nothing in the English chooses between them.
